quotelist.quote: The Salomon Highpath Snowboard is your ticket to high-alpine missions, deep days, and all-mountain mayhem.
Rock Out Camber – Flat between your bindings for stability, camber near the feet for response and a rocker on the tip/tail for pressability.
Quadratic Sidecut – A blend of elliptic curves for easy turn initiation, effortless direction changes and fluid edge-to-edge transitions
Advanced-Expert Whether you charge the steepest lines, hit the biggest jumps in the park or carve with race-like precision

citation.reasoning: evo is a major US snowboard retailer with manufacturer-supplied spec data. Highly reliable for technical specifications and pricing. Marketing language is Salomon's own.

quotelist.quote: From the backcountry to the frontside, this Salomon snowboard is built for high performance.
Uses 100% recycled materials in the sidewalls, 50% recycled materials in the base and at least 20% recycled aluminum in the edges
B/FX stringer is a patented combination of fiberglass and basalt designed to provide an optimal ratio of weight, power and dampening
